caption: The drawing features two human figures, an adult and a child. The adult, positioned centrally, has pale skin, black hair, a beard, and wears a long, flowing gown of blue with brown and red accents. The adult holds the child, who has darker skin, short black hair, and is dressed in red with a pinkish-red sash. Both figures are enclosed inside a shrine-like structure with an arched top and patterned decorations. The outer frame of the shrine is decorated with horizontal bands featuring wavy and striped patterns in shades of yellow, red, black, and green. The section above the figures is filled with floral and leaf motifs in shades of red, pink, blue, and black on a pale blue background. The interior behind the figures is brown and tan with black and red branch-like patterns along the sides and above. The drawing uses solid colors and bold outlines throughout.
title: Plate 35: Saint Joseph in Wooden Niche: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
